Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Sec. 1212 specifies that dry standpipe hose outlet valves must be located no higher than 1.20m above the floor to ensure firefighters in full gear can operate them quickly under stress.
proposed.explanation: The 1.20m maximum height accounts for ergonomic reach while wearing firefighting equipment and gloves. Valves installed too high create dangerous delays during emergency response. The same 300mm to 1.20m range applies to Siamese connection heights above exterior grade.
